checkpoints.prompt: Use method fixed-attitude-sensor-position and cite DEV-002. Compute the final field-X position of the instrument point as field_x_instrument_point_position (length, m) only if clock, orientation, acquisition, and initial position and velocity make it observable. Apply the declared calibration order: divide raw accelerometer samples by scale, subtract sensor bias, invert the x-from-y shear, and rotate into the field. Subtract upward g in the field convention. Bias-corrected gyro is zero on eligible records, so attitude stays at the declared initial orientation. Under the constant acceleration model include free_ax_m_s2, free_az_m_s2, terminal_vx_m_s, and elapsed_s operands. Use the declared constant residual field-acceleration bias bound for position uncertainty. A specific-force norm near g alone cannot determine tilt or prove that the sensor is static. Return JSON with version m5.measurement-answer.v1, method, decision, reason, citations, claims, selected_trials, quantity, operands, and corrects set to null. Use compute with eligible, or refuse with not_eligible (invalid acquisition), insufficient_evidence (required declaration absent), or unsupported_claim. Computations use one selected artifact and quantity fields value, uncertainty, estimand, dimension, and unit. Each operand names artifact, field, and value. Refusals use null quantity and empty operands and selected_trials. Cite the prescribed registry claim and state the relevant reasoning in claims as short snake_case identifiers.

methods.clock: Shared native time with prescribed gap eligibility.
methods.eligibility: Known initial attitude and state with zero corrected gyro for position or complete threshold brackets for signature.
methods.geometry: Explicit field-from-sensor attitude for a rigid-mounted individual instrument point.
limitations: An acceleration norm equal to g does not identify attitude or zero velocity.
A sensor attachment point is not a whole-athlete centre of mass.
methods.qc: Refuse clipped rails or missing/gapped observations. No integration without initial conditions.
methods.sampling: Native synthetic 20 Hz tri-axial observations on declared ideal clock.
methods.uncertainty: Conditional position error from specified constant field-acceleration bias.
